_doc: Reviewed external repositories. Nothing here is vendored: scripts/install/third_party.py clones the pinned commit and copies only listed skills with their license. Reviewed 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-08. 'copy' is allowed only for permissive licenses; others are link-only.
